SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-17: FHIRPath — §6.5 Boolean Logic. Test these items: and, or, not(), xor, implies. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §6.5.3 not() and §4.5 Singleton Evaluation of Collections
issues.root_cause: Native C++ parser treated the keyword `not` as valid after a dot but not as a standalone function token, and evalFunction dispatched `not` without checking child argument count.
issues.resolution: Added root `not()` parse support and a zero-argument guard for native `not` before dispatch
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: FP-17 focused probe, focused pytest 166 passed, native sqllogictest 594 assertions, full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §6.5 Boolean logic and §4.5 Singleton Evaluation of Collections
issues.root_cause: Direct Python helper `_get_boolean_value()` treated non-Boolean singleton operands as empty/unknown and treated multi-item operands as empty instead of applying Section 4.5 singleton Boolean evaluation.
issues.resolution: Changed direct helpers to return true for any non-Boolean singleton and raise FHIRPathError for multi-item operands
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: FP-17 focused probe, focused pytest 166 passed, native sqllogictest 594 assertions, full conformance 2822/2822.
